attributes.board_name: New Jersey Professional Counselor Examiners Committee

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses/programs from the providers listed in N.J.A.C. 13:34-15.4(a)1; the Committee itself does not approve courses.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 CEUs may be carried into the next biennial period (N.J.A.C. 13:34-15.2(e)).
rules.notes: Licenses expire November 30 of even-numbered years. The Committee states CEUs may be completed online (no limit stated on its FAQ). LAC renewal fee $180; LAC CE not stated on the FAQ.
